overview.description: The Raub Brock Dividend Growth ETF (HQDG) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in high dividend yield equity. The fund invests in US-listed equity securities of large-cap companies that have increased their dividends. The actively managed ETF employs quantitative screens focused on growth and quality characteristics. HQDG was launched on Sep 4, 2026 and is issued by Raub Brock.

holdings.infoBox: HQDG is an equity ETF with a total of 25 individual holdings. The top holdings are Casey's General Stores stock at 4.97%, Texas Instruments at 4.77%, KLA Corporation at 4.73%, The TJX Companies at 4.72%, and Microsoft at 4.70%.
